versions.changelog: Update the ClawHub display title to BondSeat - Get Difficult Restaurant Reservations. Skill instructions and connector remain unchanged.
Snag hard-to-get Resy tables through cancellation monitoring and scheduled release attempts. Explain paced availability checks and routine monitoring separate from personal Resy accounts.

Use @bondseat/mcp 0.1.1 with explicit background follow-up, diner notification, and cancellation-verification guidance. Preserves the booking outcome fixes from PR #390. The connector does not schedule itself or push updates; the agent runtime must schedule status checks.

Initial release of bondseat skill for managing Resy reservations via BondSeat.

- Find restaurants and request BondSeat to monitor or attempt automatic bookings on Resy.
- Supports booking, cancellation monitoring, scheduled release attempts, and status checks.
- No BondSeat account required; authorization handled via setup link and Stripe.
- Integrates with Node.js runtime; state file required per diner and environment.
- Manage existing requests, including stopping or resuming, with clear user instructions and data safety.
